body:
ashley: FYI pulled a partner build artifact and found what looks like an encrypted AWS secret bundle that references our STAGING role names. It's KMS-wrapped but the logs include env var labels like STG_AWS_ID.

mike: can you paste a redacted line?

ashley: redacted snippet: 
```
PUT https://partner.example.com/upload - env STG_AWS_ID=AKIA*** REMOTE_BLOB=Ci... KEY:projects/partner/locations/global/keyRings/r/cryptoKeys/ingest-key
```

dan: ingestion key appears partner-owned. main concerns: (1) did partner ever unwrap it? (2) did we forward plaintext to any services?

vault-bot: auto-alert: potential secret leakage (partner-blob). Suggested severity: P3.

security-bot: incident INC-2026-1901 created and assigned to eng-security.

mike: action plan: 1) list all artifacts referencing that keyid (ashley) 2) scan our CI logs for STG_AWS_* patterns (ashley) 3) rotate staging AWS creds if any chance of plaintext (dan) 4) rotate Vault entries mapped to STG_AWS (mike) 5) ask partner to revoke/rewrap blob (ashley+partner-oncall).

ashley: running gsutil grep now, will share hits. Expect ~5-10m.

partner-oncall: we're here. We'll revoke the KMS key binding if needed and delete artifacts on our side; we need timestamps.

ashley: found 2 artifacts in past 45 days. Saved matches to /tmp/partner-blob-hits-1792001234.txt and shared to secure drive.

dan: I'm revoking the staging IAM user keys and replacing with an assume-role flow. Creating role arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/staging-temporary now.

mike: rotating Vault secret at secret/data/staging/aws. Will bump version and issue ephemeral lease-backed creds.

ashley: partner confirms they never performed decrypt operations from an external IP; their CI just stored the blob. They'll delete the artifacts and rotate their key if any risk.

security-bot: note to ops: add CI log-scrubber to prevent full querystrings or env dumps in third-party steps. Also add a lint rule to block common AWS prefixes (AKIA).

dan: done with AWS key revoke. New flow uses STS assume-role and short TTL.

mike: Vault rotated, new version v7, TTL 1h for generated creds. I'm pushing a notification to consumers to fetch new secrets.

ashley: final: propose adding a policy change and a brief checklist to PRs that add partner integrations: never copy .env files into partner repositories; prefer dynamic secrets. Drafting PR to infra handbook.

partner-oncall: we've deleted the artifacts and rotated KMS key bindings. We'll share their scrub timestamp and audit entries.

security-bot: incident update logged; resolution target: confirm deletion and rotated credentials propagated. Next check-in in 2h.

ashley: ack, moving detailed investigation to INC-2026-1901 channel and closing this thread.

security-bot: THREAD CLOSED (moved to incident).
